<thought>Based on the 13C NMR data, the signals in the aromatic region (≈120–150 ppm) are at 143.85 ppm and 130.30 ppm. Two distinct aromatic carbon environments correspond to a para‑disubstituted benzene ring, which has four aromatic carbons (two pairs of equivalent carbons). Therefore, the molecule contains 4 aromatic carbons.</thought>
<final_answer>4</final_answer>
